expect_red: [real] switching topology keeps the leader STYLE too

mutations.contract: state.leaderStyle is a display preference, so selectTopology() never resets it -- the claim apps/viewer/topology_app.js and apps/viewer/README.md both make in prose.
mutations.note: The suite used to toggle the style back to its jogged default BEFORE its only topology switch, where a reset and a non-reset are indistinguishable. The sibling preference (jogZoneScale) was covered all along. REPAIRED 2026-09-22: the `replace` planted the literal "jogged", which was the default when this entry was written and stopped being it on 2026-09-21 (viewer_nav_alert_badge_and_angled_default moved VA.DEFAULT_LEADER_STYLE to "angled"). So the mutation no longer reset the preference -- it changed the BOOT state, and five earlier checks about the default reddened before the declared one was reached (ATTRIBUTED_ELSEWHERE, the ISSUE_20260915_card_layout_out_of_flow shape). It plants the CONSTANT now, which is what the defect actually looks like and what the guard's own comment describes -- and it cannot rot again the next time the default flips.
